question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: DECEIT
solution:
The correct answer is: **Trickery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Deceit"** means the act of concealing or misrepresenting the truth; dishonest behavior intended to mislead someone. (धोखा)
 
 
• **Example: **She used deceit to trick her colleagues into supporting her proposal.
 

 
• **"Trickery"** refers to the practice of deception and manipulation, often to achieve a specific goal or gain an advantage. (धोखाधड़ी)
 
 
• **Example: **The magician amazed the audience with his trickery and sleight of hand.
 

 
• Hence, the synonym for the word **'Deceit'** is **'Trickery'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Trickery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Honesty** (ईमानदारी): The quality of being truthful and sincere.
 
 
• **Example:** His honesty in admitting his mistake earned him respect.
 

 
• **Loyalty** (निष्ठा): A strong feeling of support or allegiance.
 
 
• **Example:** The dog’s loyalty to its owner was evident in its protective behavior.
 

 
• **Integrity** (अखंडता): The quality of being honest and having strong moral principles.
 
 
• **Example:** His integrity was never questioned, even in difficult situations.
